summary: The prepared source already contains the MiniMax-H3 CLI fix from merged upstream PR #33275. The exact reported command accepts --model-variant fl2va and reaches worker startup; no additional source correction is justified.

tests.what_was_measured: The full reported argument vector dispatches to the diffusion backend and preserves model_variant=fl2va, num_gpus=8, and ulysses_degree=8. Independent equals-form ref2va/hybrid values are accepted, while a missing value is rejected with argparse status 2.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-4b49571a85bc/venv/bin/python -c 'from sglang.cli.main import main; main()' serve --model-type diffusion --model-path MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 --num-gpus 8 --ulysses-degree 8 --performance-mode speed --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30010 --model-variant fl2va
tests.what_was_measured: The actual checkout accepted model_variant=fl2va, emitted normalized server_args, and entered eight-worker startup instead of producing the reported unrecognized-argument error. Worker ranks 1-7 then failed with invalid device ordinal because only one GPU was assigned. The launcher returned zero after shutdown; raw/exact_cli.txt contains the authoritative failure evidence.
The prepared environment imports the current server-argument test module and collects 197 tests; this is collection evidence only, not model execution.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 was visible. The exact eight-GPU command reached device initialization but failed on unavailable ranks before weights, inference, or a numerical GPU workload executed. See raw/gpu_inventory.txt and raw/exact_cli.txt.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so the reported eight-GPU Ulysses deployment could not be reproduced.
MiniMax-H3 weights were unavailable; model loading, generation, and semantic or numerical correctness were not tested.
The successful check is specifically for CLI dispatch and parsing, which is the failure reported by the issue; it is not a full serving validation.
